question: Now that the doubled scald is measured as the retune's real driver, does Steam Vent's strong slow contribute anything of its own — or is it a second inert mechanic replacing the first?
sigmaSource: hallHpAuc paired delta sd for a Steam Vent arm pair differing in one dial, measured in R2 by the registered steam-vent-scald-dial family (18,000 runs, n=3000/cell): 0.63 (maze A) / 1.05 (maze B), from the scald-8 minus scald-4 contrast. The conservative Watchtower-ladder sigma (0.87/1.41) is used for nRequired, as in that family.

regime.label: R2
regime.justification: Identical to steam-vent-scald-dial so the two families compose: that one held the slow fixed and varied the scald, this one holds the scald fixed at the adopted 8 and varies the slow. Together they decompose the retune into its two components with paired arms, replacing the cross-family inference that motivated this registration. The control again uses partnerSpecial:WATER, holding both ingredients unfused.
regime.scopeLimit: R2 bars every TERMINAL measure (0-7% of runs end with the hall alive); hallHpAuc is exempt as an integral. The cross-policy gate is empty and every verdict is provisional on it — this is MORE live here than anywhere else in the Steam Vent work, because a stationary scripted policy cannot reposition to exploit a slow, so a null is weaker evidence against a slow than against damage. This family varies ONLY TOWER.STEAM_VENT.slow.ms; factor 0.5, scald 8 and cloudMarginPx 15 are identical in both vent arms, so nothing here says the slow MAGNITUDES are wrong, only whether this slow at this strength earns its place.

decisionRule:
The burden of proof sits on the mechanic, declared before the run.

KEEP the slow when slow-on minus slow-off is resolvably positive on either maze: BH-adjusted q < 0.05 across the declared family of 12, sign test agreeing, surviving hang-imputation. Either maze is sufficient per Philip's 2026-08-04 ruling.

DROP the slow (revert to scald 8 alone, and reopen what the vent's second mechanic should be) when BOTH hold: (a) the difference is not resolvably positive on either maze, AND (b) its 95% CI EXCLUDES +0.10, the declared MDE, on both mazes. Condition (b) is what makes this an equivalence claim rather than absence of evidence.

UNRESOLVED, and NO change: a null whose CI still admits +0.10 on both mazes. The response is more n, not a revert.

Both vent arms are also reported against the two-ingredient control so each one's spec section 1 standing is visible.

SPLIT-HALF IS DECLARED UNINFORMATIVE AND IS NOT A GATE (3 arms). MONOTONICITY RULE carried from metric-selection-v2.
whatWouldRefute:
PRE-REGISTERED PREDICTION: I expect the slow to be INERT — no resolvable difference, CI inside +/-0.10 — i.e. a drop. The evidence is a cross-family comparison this family exists to replace with a paired one: steam-vent-retune's vent-old (scald 4, slow OFF) sat at -0.309 against its control, and steam-vent-scald-dial's scald-4 (scald 4, slow ON) sat at -0.302 against a control whose mean differed by 0.015. That leaves roughly +0.007 for the slow, against +0.253 for the scald doubling in the same regime.

I hold this prediction with LOW confidence and note that my last two mechanism predictions were both refuted, the most recent one in exactly this structure's favour: I predicted the scald dial was inert and it carried +0.253.

The prediction is REFUTED if slow-on beats slow-off resolvably on either maze, which would mean the cross-family inference was contaminated by the seed sets or the control difference — the precise reason this family runs paired arms instead.

If BOTH vent arms sit resolvably below the two-ingredient control on maze B, that stands regardless of which arm wins, and the vent still fails spec section 1.
notes:
WHY THIS MATTERS BEYOND ONE DIAL. The retune existed to remove a mechanic that did nothing (confusion, +0.013). Shipping a replacement mechanic that also does nothing would repeat the identical error one commit later, and it would do so while LOOKING like a fix because the co-shipped damage change carries the outcome. That is the specific failure this family exists to prevent.

SAMPLE SIZE. 1500 seeds x 2 postGaps = 3000 cells per arm per maze. 3 arms x 2 mazes x 3000 = 18,000 runs. familySize 12 = 2 non-control arms x 2 mazes x 3 metrics.

ARM CONSTRUCTION. slow-on runs the current balance table unmodified (scald 8, slow factor 0.5 / ms 1500). slow-off overrides only TOWER.STEAM_VENT.slow.ms to 0, which returns immediately at applySlow's ms <= 0 guard (server/game/status.js:75-80) — the same path a slow-immune super-fast enemy takes. No other property differs.

FRESH SEEDS: 20310801 + i, disjoint from every prior family.
